\begin{exercise} \end{exercise}1. ch10:10-24Let $(M,g)$ be a complete Riemannian manifold and $p \in M$. Show that $\text{inj}(p)$ is equal to the radius of the largest open ball in $T_p M$ on which $\exp _p$ is injective.

(Used on p. 166.) \end{exercise}
